name: capsule
note: NO capsule.js OPERATION IS WIRED INTO THE REPLAY TABLE, so this file asserts the fence rather than the module. Every capsule function mutates something real - a git worktree, a repository index, a directory removed with --force - and a scenario takes its arguments from a file, so a wired capsule op would let a scenario name any repository on the machine and stage, reset or delete inside it. The fence is drawn around the MODULE, not around its dangerous-looking half: the pure path derivation is out too, because picking which functions look safe is how the previous hole opened. The steps below prove the fence holds by asking mock-replay for each capsule operation by name and getting 'unknown op' back. The module's own behavior - the round trip, forgery unavailability through the capsule path, the machine boundary after export, crash recovery - is covered against throwaway git repositories in machine/test/capsule.test.js, which is where a real worktree can actually be built.
